description: Commands the spike harness's own local (bundled) pages may call. `switch_service` is restricted to the shell webview only, matching design §2.2.6's pattern of scoping app commands to one webview label. `spike_log` is also granted to the sp4 test page so it can forward its in-page log to Rust. Remote service pages (svc-*, isolated-*) are never listed here; SP3's `report_unread` capability is added separately, at runtime, only to the specific label(s) under test.
